faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.a1: You can manually categorize your expenses when adding them. Simply select the appropriate category for each entry to keep your finances organized.
faq.a2: Yes, we use bank-level encryption to protect your data. All your entries are stored securely and encrypted in transit and at rest.
faq.q3: Can I use Pocket on mobile?
faq.a3: Yes, Pocket is available as a Progressive Web App (PWA) that works on all mobile devices.
faq.q4: What happens if I exceed my free tier limits?
faq.a4: Pocket is currently free to use. All features are available to help you track and manage your finances.
